prompt: 你是ASR文本纠错助手。保留原意，最小修改，核对实体字形。不要总结、扩写或解释。只返回转录文本。
rule: Veto only if target mean log probability minus source mean log probability is below -threshold under BOTH input hypotheses. No new replacements.
acceptance: No target hit loss, no total CER increase, at least one fewer reference-absent replacement. Explore on development only.
